sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Spark Gemling Legionnaire is a Mercenary caster that self-casts Spark (a chaining lightning projectile) while a Cast on Crit setup triggers Comet on every critical. The Gemling Legionnaire ascendancy, Pinnacle of Power, grants bonus gem levels from attributes, and Adonia's Ego is the unique that automates the buff timeline so you cast more and manage less.

This is an advanced, high-budget caster — but the 'budget' version deletes early maps cheaply, which is why it is popular. The ceiling comes from attribute-stacked gem levels and a tight Cast on Crit uptime.

sections.title: Pros and Cons
pros: Spark chains across entire packs for effortless clear.
Cast on Crit Comet adds a huge burst on every critical.
Pinnacle of Power scales gem levels from attributes — efficient investment.
Adonia's Ego automates buffs so you manage less.
cons: Advanced to pilot — Cast on Crit uptime and buff timing need practice.
Needs a crit threshold before Comet triggers reliably.
High-budget version gets expensive (attributes, unique, gem levels).
If the trigger drops, you are a weak self-cast Spark only.

sections.title: Is This Build Right For You?
paragraphs: Pick this if you enjoy trigger-caster play, want a strong budget entry that scales to luxury, and are comfortable managing a buff timeline. If you want a passive one-button build, a different Mercenary fits better.

You must be a Mercenary who ascends Gemling Legionnaire, because Pinnacle of Power (attribute-scaled gem levels) is the core payoff. The budget version works from early maps; the luxury version needs heavy attribute investment.

steps.label: Campaign — Self-cast Spark
body: Level with self-cast Spark and a basic lightning setup. Do not add Cast on Crit until you have a crit base and the Comet gem.

steps.label: Early Maps — Add Cast on Crit
body: Once you have crit chance and Comet, wire Cast on Crit so Spark crits trigger Comet. The budget version is already strong here.

notes: Spark is the clear; Comet is the burst. Do not expect Spark alone to boss.
whyUse: Spark chains between enemies, so one cast clears a pack. It is also your crit source that feeds Cast on Crit.

skills.role: Triggers Comet on every Spark critical
whyUse: Cast on Crit is the automation: each Spark crit fires Comet, layering a big AoE burst on top of the chain.
mappingBossingDiff: On maps it clears; on bosses the Comet bursts stack on the hitbox for single-target.

skills.role: The spell Cast on Crit triggers
notes: Comet is the burst payload; scale it with the same lightning supports as Spark.

skills.role: Automates the buff timeline so you cast more
notes: Adonia's Ego is the unique that removes buff management; wear it once affordable.
Pinnacle of Power is the Gemling notable that turns attributes into gem levels — the scaling engine.

sections.title: Trigger Automation and Buff Timeline
paragraphs: Cast on Crit watches your Spark crits and fires Comet automatically — you never cast Comet by hand. Adonia's Ego then automates the periodic buffs (the 'buff timeline') that normally need manual recasting, so your only real action is casting Spark. That is why the build feels like a one-button caster despite being trigger-heavy.
The failure mode is the trigger dropping: if your crit chance dips, Comet stops firing and you are a weak self-cast Spark. Keep crit capped and the automation holds.

sections.title: Mapping Loop
paragraphs: Cast Spark into the pack; it chains and crits; Cast on Crit fires Comet on the crits; Adonia's Ego keeps buffs up. The screen clears itself while you stand and cast.

sections.title: Boss Loop
paragraphs: Cast Spark at the boss; the chained crits trigger Comet bursts that stack on the hitbox for sustained single-target. Against movers, predict the path; the Comet bursts land where the crits happen.

steps.label: Why Gemling Legionnaire
body: Pinnacle of Power grants bonus gem levels from attributes, which scales Spark, Comet, and every support at once. No other Mercenary ascendancy fuels triggers this efficiently.

steps.label: Attributes for Gem Levels
body: Path through attributes that also give life/resistances. Pinnacle of Power converts them to gem levels.

steps.label: Crit / Lightning
body: Grab crit chance and lightning damage notables to drive the trigger.

recommendations: A wand with added spell damage, cast speed, and crit. The weapon enables Spark; attributes do the scaling.
notes: Cast speed tightens the trigger loop.

sections.title: Defensive Layers
paragraphs: As a caster you keep distance and let Spark/Comet do the work; life and resistances are your floor. Adonia's Ego freeing your attention helps you reposition instead of juggling buffs. Keep a life flask and cap chaos resistance.
The biggest mistake is over-investing in attributes for gem levels and neglecting life/resistances, then dying to a stray hit. Balance the attribute stack with a survival floor.

entries.statement: The common answer is crit chance dipped below the trigger threshold — raise crit and the automation holds.

items.question: Do I need Adonia's Ego?
answer: No — it automates buffs and is the comfort upgrade, but the build functions without it via manual buff management.

items.question: Why Gemling Legionnaire?
answer: Pinnacle of Power grants gem levels from attributes, scaling Spark, Comet, and all supports at once — the efficient trigger engine.

items.question: Is this a good budget starter?
answer: The budget version deletes early maps cheaply, and it scales to luxury as you invest in attributes and crit. Yes.
